title: 18106 - 18106/P1698/005784
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Fault Code stored in Steering Wheel Electronics
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Steering Wheel Electronics for Fault Codes
technicalNotes:
Often seen in combination with 00895 being stored in Steering Wheel Electronics.
When found after a  Cruise Control Retrofit verify the 16-Steering Wheel electronics to 01-Engine control module CCS (GRA) wiring is installed and connected to the proper terminal at the Engine side.
Due to the variations of the engine configurations the pin location are not standardized and the factory wiring diagrams should be used for the specific application.
